name: Hudson River Estuary Grants: Tributary Restoration and Resiliency

funder.name: New York State Department of Environmental Conservation

summary: Round 50 Hudson River Estuary grants for dam removal, stream crossing and free-flowing tributary restoration projects that improve habitat, water quality and local flood resilience.
reporting: Quarterly narrative and expenditure reports, reimbursement documentation, and a final report are eligible administrative work.

status.quote: The New York State Department of Environmental Conservation is pleased to announce funding for projects that will help communities in the Hudson River Estuary watershed

deadline.quote: HREMP Round 50 Bid Due Date: December 17, 2026, by 3:00 p.m. ET

applicant_types.quote: 501(c)(3) not-for-profit corporations, Governmental Entities, Municipalities, and Quasi-Governmental Entities

geography.quote: Eligible projects for grant funding must be located within defined geographic boundaries of the Hudson River Estuary watershed

access.quote: Bids must be submitted through the NYS SFS Grants Management System.

amount.quote: The minimum grant amount is $10,500. The maximum grant amount is $200,000.

pool.quote: Approximately $400,000 is available from the NYS Environmental Protection Fund.

co_finance_required.quote: For this grant opportunity, Bidders must match at least 10% of the grant funding amount.

reporting.quote: preparation of quarterly narrative and expenditure reports, reimbursement request documentation, and preparation of the final report upon project completion
